pages.title: Before the Dive
pages.text: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find gatekeepers using their locators or native structures. Their order is free. This groups real admission conditions; the campaign remains their authority.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Locate and confront the ghostly Captain Cornelia in the ship graveyard. Boss/story reward tied to the Ice Maze.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Find a Shell Horn in frozen pirate ships and use it near water inside the Ice Maze. Native documentation identifies it as the Cornelia summoning item.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Sea Viper: cold oceans and swimmer displacement; the tooth grants underwater vision/defense.
